name: Do I need a structural engineer for a second-story addition?

mainEntity.name: Do I need a structural engineer for a second-story addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, a structural engineer is typically essential for a second-story addition. They assess the existing foundation and load-bearing walls to determine if they can support the additional weight of a new story. If the current structure is insufficient, the engineer will design necessary reinforcements. Their involvement ensures the safety and stability of the entire home and is often a requirement for building permits in the Las Vegas area.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, a structural engineer is typically essential to assess the existing foundation and design necessary reinforcements for a second story.
